verses.text: Di word wey come to Jeremiah from di Lord, say,
“Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis: ‘Write all di words wey I don speak to you for book.

Because see, di days dey come,’ talk di Lord, ‘wey I go turn again di captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ talk di Lord. ‘I go cause dem to return to di land wey I give to dem fathers, and dem go possess am.’”
Dis na di words wey di Lord speak concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
For di Lord talk like dis: “We don hear voice of trembling, of fear, and no peace.
Ask now, and see whether man dey travail with child. Why I see every man with im hands on im loins, like woman for labour, and all faces turn pale?
Alas! Because dat day great, so that none dey like am. E na time of Jacob trouble, but e go dey saved out of am.
E go happen for dat day,” talk di Lord of Armies, “say I go break im yoke from off your neck, and I go burst your bonds. Strangers no go make am serve demselves again,
but dem go serve di Lord dem God, and David dem king, wey I go raise up to dem.

Therefore no fear, my servant Jacob,” talk di Lord, “neither dey dismayed, Israel, because see, I go save you from far, and your offspring from di land of dem captivity. Jacob go return, and go dey quiet and at ease, and none go make am afraid.

Because I dey with you,” talk di Lord, “to save you. Though I make full end of all di nations where I don scatter you, yet I no go make full end of you, but I go correct you in measure, and I no go leave you altogether unpunished.”
Because di Lord talk like dis: “Your hurt dey incurable, and your wound grievous.
Dey none to plead your cause, so that you go dey bound up. You no get healing medicines.

All your lovers don forget you. Dem no seek you. Because I don wound you with di wound of enemy, with di chastisement of cruel one, because of di greatness of your iniquity, because your sins dey increased.
Why you cry for your hurt? Your pain dey incurable. Because of di greatness of your iniquity, because your sins dey increased, I don do dis things to you.
Therefore all dem wey devour you go dey devoured, and all your adversaries, every one of dem, go go into captivity. Dem wey plunder you go be plunder, and all wey prey on you I go give for prey.
Because I go restore health to you, and I go heal you of your wounds,” talk di Lord, “because dem don call you outcast, saying, ‘Na Zion, wey nobody care for.’”
Di Lord talk like dis: “See, I go turn again di captivity of Jacob tents, and have compassion on im dwelling places. Di city go dey built on im own hill, and di palace go remain as e suppose.
Out of dem go proceed thanksgiving and di voice of dem wey make merry. I go multiply dem, and dem no go be few. I go glorify dem, and dem no go be small.
Dem children go be as before, and dem congregation go dey established before me. I go punish all wey oppress dem.
Dem prince go be of dem own, and dem ruler go proceed from di middle of dem. I go cause am to draw near, and e go approach me, because who be dis wey pledge im heart to approach me?” talk di Lord.
“Una go be my people, and I go be una God.”
See, di storm of di Lord, even im wrath, don go out, sweeping storm. E go burst on di head of di wicked.
Di fierce anger of di Lord no go return, until e don executed and performed di intentions of im heart. For di latter days una go understand am.
“For dat time,” talk di Lord, “I go be di God of all di families of Israel, and dem go be my people.”
Di Lord talk like dis: “Di people wey survive di sword find favour for di wilderness, even Israel, when I go to give am rest.”
Di Lord appear to me from far, saying, “Yes, I don love you with everlasting love. Therefore I don continue loving kindness to you.
Again I go build you, and you go dey built, virgin of Israel. Again you go decorate yourself with your tambourines, and go go out for di dances of dem wey make merry.
Again you go plant vineyards on di mountains of Samaria. Di planters go plant, and go enjoy di fruit.
Because day go dey wey di watchmen for di hills of Ephraim go cry, ‘Arise, make we go up to Zion, to di Lord our God.’”
Because di Lord talk like dis: “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for di chief of di nations. Publish, praise, and talk, ‘Di Lord, save your people, di remnant of Israel!’

See, I go bring dem from di north country, and gather dem from di uttermost parts of di earth, and with dem di blind and di lame, di woman wey dey with child and her wey dey labour with child together. Great company go return here.

Dem go come with weeping, and with supplications I go lead dem. I go cause dem to waka by rivers of waters, for straight way wey dem no go stumble, because I be papa to Israel, and Ephraim na my firstborn.
Hear di word of di Lord, una nations, and declare am for di islands afar off, and talk, ‘Im wey scatter Israel go gather am, and keep am, as shepherd dey do im flock.’
Because di Lord don ransom Jacob, and don redeem am from di hand of im wey dey stronger pass am.

Dem go come and sing for di height of Zion, and go flow to di goodness of di Lord, to di grain, and to di new wine, and to di oil, and to di young of di flock and of di herd. Dem soul go be like watered garden, and dem no go sorrow any more at all.
Den di virgin go rejoice for di dance, and di young men and old men together, because I go turn dem mourning into joy, and go comfort dem, and make dem rejoice from dem sorrow.
I go satisfy di soul of di priests with abundance, and my people go dey satisfied with my goodness,” talk di Lord.
Di Lord talk like dis: “Voice dey heard for Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuse to dey comforted for her children, because dem no dey.”
Di Lord talk like dis: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, because your work go dey rewarded,” talk di Lord. “Dem go come again from di land of di enemy.
Hope dey for your future,” talk di Lord, “and your children go come again to dem own border.
I don surely hear Ephraim bemoaning imself: ‘You don chastise me, and I dey chastised, like untrained calf. Turn me, and I go dey turned, because you be di Lord my God.
Surely after dat I dey turned, I repent. After I dey instructed, I strike my thigh. I dey ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bear di reproach of my youth.’

No be Ephraim be my dear son? No be pleasant child? Because as often as I speak against am, I still earnestly remember am. Therefore my heart yearn for am. I go surely have mercy on am,” talk di Lord.
“Set up road signs. Make for yourself guideposts. Set your heart toward di highway, di way wey you waka. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to dis your cities.
How long you go go here and dere, backsliding daughter? Because di Lord don create new thing for di earth: woman go encircle man.”

Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: “Again dem go use dis speech for di land of Judah and for im cities, when I don turn again dem captivity: ‘Di Lord bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’
Judah and all im cities go dwell together inside am, farmers and dem wey go about with flocks.
Because I don satisfy di weary soul, and every sorrowful soul I don replenish.”
Upon dis I awake, and look, and my sleep dey sweet to me.
“See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey I go sow di house of Israel and di house of Judah with di seed of man and with di seed of animal.
E go happen say as I don watch over dem to pluck up, to break down, to overthrow, to destroy, and to afflict, so I go watch over dem to build and to plant,” talk di Lord.
“For dose days dem go no more talk, ‘Di fathers don eat sour grapes, and di teeth of di children dey set on edge.’
But everyone go die for im own iniquity. Every man wey eat di sour grapes, im teeth go dey set on edge.
See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey I go make new covenant with di house of Israel and with di house of Judah,

no according to di covenant wey I make with dem fathers for di day wey I take dem by di hand to bring dem out of di land of Egypt, di covenant of mine wey dem break, although I be husband to dem,” talk di Lord.

“But dis na di covenant wey I go make with di house of Israel after dose days,” talk di Lord. “I go put my law for dem inward parts, and I go write am for dem heart. I go be dem God, and dem go be my people.

Dem no go teach again everyone im neighbour, and everyone im brother, saying, ‘Know di Lord,’ because dem all go know me, from di least of dem to di greatest of dem,” talk di Lord, “because I go forgive dem iniquity, and I go remember dem sin no more.”
Di Lord, wey give di sun for light by day, and di ordinances of di moon and of di stars for light by night, wey stir up di sea so that im waves roar, di Lord of Armies na im name, talk like dis:
“If dose ordinances depart from before me,” talk di Lord, “den di offspring of Israel go also cease from being nation before me forever.”
Di Lord talk like dis: “If di heavens above fit dey measured, and di foundations of di earth beneath searched out, I go also cast off all di offspring of Israel for all wey dem don do,” talk di Lord.
“See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey di city go dey built to di Lord from di tower of Hananel to di Corner Gate.
Di measuring line go go out further straight to di hill Gareb, and go turn to Goah.

Di whole valley of di dead bodies and of di ashes, and all di fields to di brook Kidron, to di corner of di Horse Gate toward di east, go be holy to di Lord. E no go dey plucked up, nor thrown down any more forever.”
Di word wey come to Jeremiah from di Lord for di tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, wey be di eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
Now di king of Babylon army dey besiege Jerusalem, and Jeremiah di prophet dey shut up for di court of di guard, wey dey di house of di king of Judah.
Because Zedekiah king of Judah don shut am up, saying, “Why you prophesy, and talk, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: See, I go give dis city into di hand of di king of Babylon, and e go capture am.
Zedekiah king of Judah no go escape out of di hand of di Chaldeans, but go surely dey delivered into di hand of di king of Babylon, and go speak with am mouth to mouth, and im eyes go see im eyes.
E go lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and e go dey dere until I visit am,’ talk di Lord. ‘Though una fight with di Chaldeans, una no go prosper’?”
Jeremiah talk, “Di word of di Lord come to me, say,
‘See, Hanamel, Shallum your uncle pikin, go come to you, saying, “Buy my field wey dey Anathoth, because di right of redemption dey yours to buy am.”’

So Hanamel my uncle pikin come to me for di court of di guard according to di word of di Lord, and talk to me, ‘Buy my field, I beg you, wey dey Anathoth, wey dey di land of Benjamin, because di right of inheritance dey yours, and di redemption dey yours. Buy am for yourself.’ Den I know say dis na di word of di Lord.
I buy di field wey dey Anathoth from Hanamel my uncle pikin, and I weigh am di money, 17 shekels of silver.
I sign di deed, and seal am, and call witnesses, and weigh di money for di scales.
So I take di deed of di purchase, both dat wey dem seal, containing di terms and conditions, and dat wey dem leave open.

I give di deed of di purchase to Baruch, Neriah pikin, Maaseiah pikin, for di sight of Hanamel my uncle pikin, and for di presence of di witnesses wey sign di deed of di purchase, before all di Jews wey sit for di court of di guard.
I charge Baruch before dem, saying,

‘Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Take dis deeds, dis deed of di purchase, both dat wey dem seal and dis deed wey dem leave open, and put dem for earthen vessel, so that dem go continue many days.
Because di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Houses and fields and vineyards go dey bought again for dis land.’
Now after I don deliver di deed of di purchase to Baruch, Neriah pikin, I pray to di Lord, saying,
‘Ah Lord God! See, you don make di heavens and di earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. Nothing dey too hard for you,
wey show loving kindness to thousands, and repay di iniquity of di fathers into di bosom of dem children after dem, di great, di mighty God, wey im name na di Lord of Armies,
great for counsel, and mighty for work, wey im eyes dey open on all di ways of di sons of men, to give everyone according to im ways, and according to di fruit of im doings,
wey don set signs and wonders for di land of Egypt, even to dis day, both for Israel and among other men, and don make yourself name, as e dey dis day,
and don bring forth your people Israel out of di land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with strong hand, and with outstretched arm, and with great terror,
and don give dem dis land, wey you swear to dem fathers to give dem, land flowing with milk and honey.
Dem come in, and possess am, but dem no obey your voice, neither waka for your law. Dem no do anything of all wey you command dem to do. Therefore you don cause all dis evil to come on dem.

See, di siege mounds don reach di city to capture am, and di city dey given into di hand of di Chaldeans wey fight against am, because of di sword, and of di famine, and of di pestilence. Wetin you don speak don come to pass, and see, you see am.
You don talk to me, Lord God, “Buy di field for money, and call witnesses,” though di city dey given into di hand of di Chaldeans.’”
Den di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, say,
“See, I be di Lord, di God of all flesh. Anything dey too hard for me?
Therefore di Lord talk like dis: ‘See, I go give dis city into di hand of di Chaldeans, and into di hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and e go capture am.

Di Chaldeans wey fight against dis city go come and set dis city on fire, and burn am, with di houses, on whose roofs dem don offer incense to Baal, and pour out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.
Because di children of Israel and di children of Judah don do only evil for my sight from dem youth. Di children of Israel don only provoke me to anger with di work of dem hands,’ talk di Lord.
‘Because dis city don be to me provocation of my anger and of my wrath from di day wey dem build am even to dis day, so that I go remove am from before my face,

because of all di evil of di children of Israel and of di children of Judah, wey dem don do to provoke me to anger, dem, dem kings, dem princes, dem priests, and dem prophets, and di men of Judah, and di inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Dem don turn to me di back, and no di face, though I teach dem, rising up early and teaching dem, yet dem no listen to receive instruction.
But dem set dem abominations for di house wey dem call by my name, to defile am.

Dem build di high places of Baal wey dey di valley of di son of Hinnom, to cause dem sons and dem daughters to pass through di fire to Molech, wey I no command dem, neither e come into my mind, say dem should do dis abomination, to cause Judah to sin.’
Now therefore di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis concerning dis city, wey una talk say, “E dey given into di hand of di king of Babylon by di sword, and by di famine, and by di pestilence”:
‘See, I go gather dem out of all di countries, where I don drive dem for my anger, and for my wrath, and for great indignation. I go bring dem again to dis place, and I go cause dem to dwell safely.
Dem go be my people, and I go be dem God.
I go give dem one heart and one way, so that dem go fear me forever, for di good of dem and of dem children after dem.
I go make everlasting covenant with dem, say I no go turn away from following dem, to do dem good. I go put my fear for dem heart, so that dem no go depart from me.
Yes, I go rejoice over dem to do dem good, and I go plant dem for dis land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.’
Because di Lord talk like dis: ‘Just as I don bring all dis great evil on dis people, so I go bring on dem all di good wey I don promise dem.
Fields go dey bought for dis land, wey una talk say na desolation, without man or animal. E dey given into di hand of di Chaldeans.

Men go buy fields for money, and sign di deeds, and seal dem, and call witnesses, for di land of Benjamin, and for di places round about Jerusalem, and for di cities of Judah, and for di cities of di hill country, and for di cities of di lowland, and for di cities of di South, because I go cause dem captivity to return,’ talk di Lord.”
Di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah di second time, while e still dey shut up for di court of di guard, say,
“Di Lord wey make am, di Lord wey form am to establish am (di Lord na im name), talk like dis:
‘Call to me, and I go answer you, and show you great and mighty things, wey you no know.’

Because di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis concerning di houses of dis city, and concerning di houses of di kings of Judah, wey dem throw down to fortify against di siege mounds and against di sword,
while dem dey come to fight with di Chaldeans, and to fill dem with di dead bodies of men, wey I don kill for my anger and for my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I don hide my face from dis city:
See, I go bring am health and healing, and I go heal dem, and I go reveal to dem abundance of peace and truth.
I go cause di captivity of Judah and di captivity of Israel to return, and I go build dem as at di first.
I go cleanse dem from all dem iniquity, wey dem don sin against me, and I go pardon all dem iniquities, wey dem don sin against me, and wey dem don transgress against me.

Dis city go be to me name of joy, praise and glory, before all di nations of di earth, wey go hear all di good wey I do to dem, and go fear and tremble for all di good and for all di peace wey I give am.”

Di Lord talk like dis: “Again dey go dey heard for dis place, wey una talk say, ‘E dey waste, without man and without animal,’ even for di cities of Judah, and for di streets of Jerusalem, wey dey desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without animal,

di voice of joy and di voice of gladness, di voice of di bridegroom and di voice of di bride, di voice of dem wey go talk, ‘Give thanks to di Lord of Armies, because di Lord dey good, because im loving kindness endure forever,’ and of dem wey bring sacrifices of thanksgiving into di house of di Lord. Because I go cause di captivity of di land to return as at di first,” talk di Lord.
Di Lord of Armies talk like dis: “Again for dis place, wey dey waste, without man and without animal, and for all im cities, go be habitation of shepherds causing dem flocks to lie down.

For di cities of di hill country, for di cities of di lowland, and for di cities of di South, and for di land of Benjamin, and for di places round about Jerusalem, and for di cities of Judah, di flocks go again pass under di hands of di one wey count dem,” talk di Lord.
“See, di days dey come,” talk di Lord, “wey I go perform di good word wey I don speak concerning di house of Israel and concerning di house of Judah.
For dose days, and for dat time, I go cause Branch of righteousness to grow up to David, and e go execute justice and righteousness for di land.
For dose days Judah go dey saved, and Jerusalem go dwell safely. Dis na di name wey dem go call am: di Lord our righteousness.”
Because di Lord talk like dis: “David no go lack man to sit on di throne of di house of Israel,
neither di priests di Levites go lack man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.”
Di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, say,
“Di Lord talk like dis: ‘If una fit break my covenant of di day, and my covenant of di night, so that day and night no go dey for dem season,
den my covenant with David my servant fit dey broken, so that e no go get son to reign on im throne, and with di Levites di priests, my ministers.
As di army of heaven no fit dey numbered, neither di sand of di sea measured, so I go multiply di offspring of David my servant, and di Levites wey minister to me.’”
Di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, say,
“You no consider wetin dis people don speak, saying, ‘Di two families wey di Lord don choose, e don reject dem’? Dem despise my people, so that dem no be nation before dem again.
Di Lord talk like dis: ‘If my covenant of day and night no stand, if I no appoint di ordinances of heaven and earth,

den I go also cast away di offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I no go take any of im offspring to be rulers over di offspring of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Because I go cause dem captivity to return, and I go have mercy on dem.’”

Di word wey come to Jeremiah from di Lord, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all im army, and all di kingdoms of di earth wey dey under im dominion, and all di peoples, fight against Jerusalem, and against all di cities of dem, say,

“Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell am, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: See, I go give dis city into di hand of di king of Babylon, and e go burn am with fire.
You no go escape out of im hand, but go surely dey taken, and delivered into im hand. Your eyes go see di eyes of di king of Babylon, and e go speak with you mouth to mouth, and you go go to Babylon.
Yet hear di word of di Lord, Zedekiah king of Judah. Di Lord talk like dis concerning you: You no go die by di sword.

You go die in peace. As dem burn spices for your fathers, di former kings wey dey before you, so dem go burn spices for you. Dem go lament for you, saying, “Ah lord!” because I don speak di word,’ talk di Lord.”
Den Jeremiah di prophet speak all dis words to Zedekiah king of Judah for Jerusalem,

when di king of Babylon army fight against Jerusalem, and against all di cities of Judah wey remain, against Lachish and against Azekah, because dem na di only fortified cities wey remain among di cities of Judah.
Di word wey come to Jeremiah from di Lord, after di king Zedekiah don make covenant with all di people wey dey Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to dem,
so that every man go let im male servant, and every man im female servant, wey be Hebrew man or Hebrew woman, go free, so that nobody go make servant of dem, even of im brother Jew.

All di princes and all di people wey enter into di covenant obey, say everyone go let im male servant, and everyone im female servant, go free, so that nobody go make servant of dem again. Dem obey, and let dem go.
But afterward dem turn, and cause di servants and di maids, wey dem don let go free, to return, and dem bring dem into subjection for servants and for maids.
Therefore di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah from di Lord, say,
“Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis: I make covenant with una fathers for di day wey I bring dem out of di land of Egypt, out of di house of bondage, saying,

‘At di end of seven years una go each let go im brother wey be Hebrew, wey don sell imself to you, and don serve you six years. Una go let am go free from you.’ But una fathers no listen to me, neither incline dem ear.
You turn today, and do wetin dey right for my eyes, to proclaim liberty, everyone to im neighbour, and una make covenant before me for di house wey dem call by my name.

But una turn and profane my name, and cause everyone im male servant, and everyone im female servant, wey una don set free at dem pleasure, to return, and bring dem into subjection to be una male servants and una female servants.

Therefore di Lord talk like dis: Una no obey me, to proclaim liberty, everyone to im brother, and everyone to im neighbour. See, I proclaim for una liberty,” talk di Lord, “to di sword, to di pestilence, and to di famine. I go make una be tossed to and fro among all di kingdoms of di earth.
I go give di men wey don transgress my covenant, wey no perform di words of di covenant wey dem make before me, di calf wey dem cut in two and pass between im parts:
di princes of Judah, di princes of Jerusalem, di eunuchs, di priests, and all di people of di land, wey pass between di parts of di calf.
I go give dem into di hand of dem enemies, and into di hand of dem wey seek dem life. Dem dead bodies go be food for di birds of di sky, and for di animals of di earth.
I go give Zedekiah king of Judah and im princes into di hand of dem enemies, and into di hand of dem wey seek dem life, and into di hand of di king of Babylon army, wey don go up from una.
See, I go command,” talk di Lord, “and cause dem to return to dis city. Dem go fight against am, and capture am, and burn am with fire. I go make di cities of Judah desolation, without inhabitant.”
Di word wey come to Jeremiah from di Lord for di days of Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah, say,
“Go to di house of di Rechabites, and speak to dem, and bring dem into di house of di Lord, into one of di chambers, and give dem wine to drink.”
Den I take Jaazaniah, Jeremiah pikin, Habazziniah pikin, and im brothers, and all im sons, and di whole house of di Rechabites,

and I bring dem into di house of di Lord, into di chamber of di sons of Hanan, Igdaliah pikin, di man of God, wey dey by di chamber of di princes, wey dey above di chamber of Maaseiah, Shallum pikin, di keeper of di threshold.
I set before di sons of di house of di Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups, and I talk to dem, “Drink wine.”
But dem talk, “We no go drink wine, because Jonadab, Rechab pikin, our father, command us, saying, ‘Una no go drink wine, neither una nor una sons, forever.
Neither una go build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor get any, but all una days una go dwell for tents, so that una go live many days for di land where una dey sojourn.’
We don obey di voice of Jonadab, Rechab pikin, our father, for all wey e charge us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters,
nor to build houses for us to dwell inside. We no get vineyard, nor field, nor seed.
But we don dwell for tents, and don obey, and do according to all wey Jonadab our father command us.

But e happen, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come up into di land, say we talk, ‘Come, make we go to Jerusalem for fear of di army of di Chaldeans, and for fear of di army of Syria.’ So we dwell for Jerusalem.”
Den di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, say,
“Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Go, and tell di men of Judah and di inhabitants of Jerusalem, ‘You no go receive instruction to listen to my words?’ talk di Lord.

‘Di words of Jonadab, Rechab pikin, wey e command im sons, say dem no go drink wine, dey performed. Dem no drink wine to dis day, because dem obey dem father command. But I don speak to una, rising up early and speaking, yet una no listen to me.

I don send also to una all my servants di prophets, rising up early and sending dem, saying, “Return now everyone from im evil way, and amend una doings, and no go after other gods to serve dem. Una go dwell for di land wey I don give to una and to una fathers.” But una no incline una ear, nor listen to me.
Surely di sons of Jonadab, Rechab pikin, don perform di commandment of dem father, wey e command dem, but dis people no listen to me.’

Therefore di Lord, di God of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: ‘See, I go bring on Judah and on all di inhabitants of Jerusalem all di evil wey I don pronounce against dem, because I don speak to dem, but dem no hear, and I don call to dem, but dem no answer.’”

Jeremiah talk to di house of di Rechabites, “Di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: ‘Because una don obey di commandment of Jonadab una father, and keep all im precepts, and do according to all wey e command una,
therefore di Lord of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Jonadab, Rechab pikin, no go lack man to stand before me forever.’”
E happen for di fourth year of Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah, say dis word come to Jeremiah from di Lord, say,

“Take scroll of book, and write inside am all di words wey I don speak to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all di nations, from di day wey I speak to you, from di days of Josiah, even to dis day.
Maybe di house of Judah go hear all di evil wey I plan to do to dem, so that dem go return everyone from im evil way, and I go forgive dem iniquity and dem sin.”
Den Jeremiah call Baruch, Neriah pikin, and Baruch write from di mouth of Jeremiah all di words of di Lord, wey e don speak to am, on scroll of book.
Jeremiah command Baruch, saying, “I dey shut up. I no fit go into di house of di Lord.

Therefore you go go, and read from di scroll, wey you don write from my mouth, di words of di Lord for di ears of di people for di Lord house for di fasting day. Also you go read dem for di ears of all Judah wey come out of dem cities.
Maybe dem go present dem supplication before di Lord, and go return everyone from im evil way, because great na di anger and di wrath wey di Lord don pronounce against dis people.”
Baruch, Neriah pikin, do according to all wey Jeremiah di prophet command am, reading from di book di words of di Lord for di Lord house.

Now e happen for di fifth year of Jehoiakim, Josiah pikin, king of Judah, for di ninth month, say dem proclaim fast before di Lord to all di people for Jerusalem, and to all di people wey come from di cities of Judah to Jerusalem.

Den Baruch read from di book di words of Jeremiah for di house of di Lord, for di chamber of Gemariah, Shaphan pikin, di scribe, for di upper court, for di entry of di new gate of di Lord house, for di ears of all di people.
When Micaiah, Gemariah pikin, Shaphan pikin, don hear out of di book all di words of di Lord,

e go down to di king house, into di scribe chamber. See, all di princes dey sit dere: Elishama di scribe, and Delaiah, Shemaiah pikin, and Elnathan, Achbor pikin, and Gemariah, Shaphan pikin, and Zedekiah, Hananiah pikin, and all di princes.
Den Micaiah declare to dem all di words wey e hear, when Baruch read di book for di ears of di people.

Therefore all di princes send Jehudi, Nethaniah pikin, Shelemiah pikin, Cushi pikin, to Baruch, saying, “Take for your hand di scroll wey you read for di ears of di people, and come.” So Baruch, Neriah pikin, take di scroll for im hand, and come to dem.
Dem talk to am, “Sit down now, and read am for our ears.” So Baruch read am for dem ears.
Now e happen, when dem don hear all di words, say dem turn in fear one toward another, and talk to Baruch, “We go surely tell di king all dis words.”
Dem ask Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how you write all dis words from im mouth?”
Baruch answer dem, “E pronounce all dis words to me with im mouth, and I write dem with ink for di book.”
Den di princes talk to Baruch, “Go, hide yourself, you and Jeremiah, and make nobody know where una dey.”
Dem go in to di king for di court, but dem don deposit di scroll for di chamber of Elishama di scribe. Dem tell all di words for di ears of di king.
So di king send Jehudi to fetch di scroll, and e take am out of di chamber of Elishama di scribe. Jehudi read am for di ears of di king, and for di ears of all di princes wey stand beside di king.
Now di king dey sit for di winter house for di ninth month, with fire burning for di brazier before am.
E happen, when Jehudi don read three or four columns, say di king cut am with di penknife, and cast am into di fire wey dey di brazier, until all di scroll consume for di fire wey dey di brazier.
Yet dem no dey afraid, nor tear dem garments, neither di king, nor any of im servants wey hear all dis words.
Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah make intercession to di king say make e no burn di scroll, but e no listen to dem.
Di king command Jerahmeel di king son, and Seraiah, Azriel pikin, and Shelemiah, Abdeel pikin, to seize Baruch di scribe and Jeremiah di prophet, but di Lord hide dem.
Den di word of di Lord come to Jeremiah, after di king don burn di scroll, and di words wey Baruch write from di mouth of Jeremiah, say,
“Take another scroll again, and write inside am all di former words wey dey di first scroll, wey Jehoiakim di king of Judah don burn.

Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you go talk, ‘Di Lord talk like dis: You don burn dis scroll, saying, “Why you don write inside am, saying, ‘Di king of Babylon go certainly come and destroy dis land, and go cause man and animal to cease from am’?”
Therefore di Lord talk like dis concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: E no go get anyone to sit on di throne of David. Im dead body go dey cast out to di heat by day, and to di frost by night.

I go punish am and im offspring and im servants for dem iniquity. I go bring on dem, and on di inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on di men of Judah, all di evil wey I don pronounce against dem, but dem no listen.’”

Den Jeremiah take another scroll, and give am to Baruch di scribe, Neriah pikin, who write inside am from di mouth of Jeremiah all di words of di book wey Jehoiakim king of Judah don burn for di fire. Many similar words dey added to dem.
Zedekiah, Josiah pikin, reign as king instead of Coniah, Jehoiakim pikin, wey Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon make king for di land of Judah.
But neither e, nor im servants, nor di people of di land, listen to di words of di Lord, wey e speak by di prophet Jeremiah.
Zedekiah di king send Jehucal, Shelemiah pikin, and Zephaniah, Maaseiah pikin, di priest, to di prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to di Lord our God for us.”
Now Jeremiah dey come in and go out among di people, because dem never put am for prison.
Pharaoh army don come out of Egypt. When di Chaldeans wey dey besiege Jerusalem hear di news about dem, dem depart from Jerusalem.
Den di word of di Lord come to di prophet Jeremiah, say,
“Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk like dis: Una go talk to di king of Judah, wey send una to me to inquire of me: ‘See, Pharaoh army, wey don come out to help una, go return to Egypt, to dem own land.
Di Chaldeans go come again, and fight against dis city. Dem go capture am, and burn am with fire.’
Di Lord talk like dis: Make una no deceive yourselves, saying, ‘Di Chaldeans go surely depart from us,’ because dem no go depart.
Because though una strike di whole army of di Chaldeans wey fight against una, and dem wey remain among dem na only wounded men, yet dem go rise up everyone for im tent, and burn dis city with fire.”
E happen, when di army of di Chaldeans don break up from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh army,
say Jeremiah go out of Jerusalem to go into di land of Benjamin, to receive im portion dere among di people.
When e dey di Benjamin Gate, one captain of di guard dey dere, wey im name na Irijah, Shelemiah pikin, Hananiah pikin. E seize Jeremiah di prophet, saying, “You dey fall away to di Chaldeans.”
Den Jeremiah talk, “Na lie! I no dey fall away to di Chaldeans.” But e no listen to am. So Irijah seize Jeremiah, and bring am to di princes.
Di princes dey angry with Jeremiah, and strike am, and put am for prison for di house of Jonathan di scribe, because dem don make dat di prison.
When Jeremiah don enter di dungeon house, and di cells, and Jeremiah don remain dere many days,

Zedekiah di king send, and take am out. Di king ask am secretly for im house, and talk, “Word dey from di Lord?” Jeremiah talk, “Yes,” and e talk, “You go dey delivered into di hand of di king of Babylon.”
Moreover Jeremiah talk to King Zedekiah, “Wetin I don offend you, or your servants, or dis people, say una don put me for prison?
Where now your prophets wey prophesy to una, saying, ‘Di king of Babylon no go come against una, nor against dis land’?
Now hear, I beg you, my lord di king. Make my supplication dey accepted before you, so that you no go cause me to return to di house of Jonathan di scribe, lest I die dere.”

Den Zedekiah di king command, and dem commit Jeremiah into di court of di guard, and dem give am daily one loaf of bread from di bakers street, until all di bread for di city dey consumed. So Jeremiah remain for di court of di guard.
Shephatiah, Mattan pikin, and Gedaliah, Pashhur pikin, and Jucal, Shelemiah pikin, and Pashhur, Malchijah pikin, hear di words wey Jeremiah speak to all di people, saying,

“Di Lord talk like dis: ‘Im wey stay for dis city go die by di sword, by di famine, and by di pestilence, but im wey go out to di Chaldeans go live, and im life go be to am for plunder, and e go live.’
Di Lord talk like dis: ‘Dis city go surely dey given into di hand of di army of di king of Babylon, and e go capture am.’”

Den di princes talk to di king, “Make dis man dey put to death, because e dey weaken di hands of di men of war wey remain for dis city, and di hands of all di people, in speaking such words to dem. Because dis man no dey seek di welfare of dis people, but di harm.”
Zedekiah di king talk, “See, e dey for your hand, because di king no fit do anything against you.”

Den dem take Jeremiah, and cast am into di dungeon of Malchijah di king son, wey dey di court of di guard. Dem let down Jeremiah with ropes. For di dungeon no water dey, but only mire. Jeremiah sink for di mire.
Now when Ebed Melech di Ethiopian, one eunuch wey dey di king house, hear say dem don put Jeremiah for di dungeon (di king dey sit for di Benjamin Gate),
Ebed Melech go out of di king house, and speak to di king, saying,

“My lord di king, dis men don do evil for all wey dem don do to Jeremiah di prophet, wey dem don cast into di dungeon. E go die where e dey because of di famine, because no more bread dey for di city.”
Den di king command Ebed Melech di Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here 30 men with you, and lift Jeremiah di prophet up out of di dungeon, before e die.”
So Ebed Melech take di men with am, and go into di house of di king under di treasury, and take from dere old rags and worn-out garments, and let dem down by ropes into di dungeon to Jeremiah.
Ebed Melech di Ethiopian talk to Jeremiah, “Put now dis old rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under di ropes.” Jeremiah do so.
So dem draw up Jeremiah with di ropes, and take am up out of di dungeon. Jeremiah remain for di court of di guard.
Den Zedekiah di king send, and take Jeremiah di prophet to am into di third entry wey dey di house of di Lord. Di king talk to Jeremiah, “I go ask you one thing. Hide nothing from me.”
Den Jeremiah talk to Zedekiah, “If I declare am to you, you no go surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you no go listen to me.”
So Zedekiah di king swear secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As di Lord live, wey make dis soul for us, I no go put you to death, neither I go give you into di hand of dis men wey seek your life.”

Den Jeremiah talk to Zedekiah, “Di Lord, di God of Armies, di God of Israel, talk like dis: ‘If you go out to di king of Babylon princes, den your soul go live, and dis city no go dey burned with fire, and you go live, and your house.
But if you no go out to di king of Babylon princes, den dis city go dey given into di hand of di Chaldeans, and dem go burn am with fire, and you no go escape out of dem hand.’”
Zedekiah di king talk to Jeremiah, “I dey afraid of di Jews wey don fall away to di Chaldeans, lest dem deliver me into dem hand, and dem mock me.”
But Jeremiah talk, “Dem no go deliver you. Obey, I beg you, di voice of di Lord, for wetin I speak to you. So e go dey well with you, and your soul go live.
But if you refuse to go out, dis na di word wey di Lord don show me:

See, all di women wey dey remain for di king of Judah house go dey brought out to di king of Babylon princes, and dem go talk, ‘Your trusted friends don deceive you, and don prevail over you. Now wey your feet don sink for di mire, dem don turn away back.’
Dem go bring out all your wives and your children to di Chaldeans. You go no escape out of dem hand, but go dey taken by di hand of di king of Babylon. You go cause dis city to dey burned with fire.”
Den Zedekiah talk to Jeremiah, “Make no man know of dis words, and you no go die.

But if di princes hear say I don talk with you, and dem come to you, and talk to you, ‘Declare to us now wetin you don talk to di king. Hide am no from us, and we no go put you to death. Also wetin di king talk to you,’
den you go talk to dem, ‘I present my supplication before di king, say make e no cause me to return to Jonathan house, to die dere.’”
Den all di princes come to Jeremiah, and ask am. E tell dem according to all dis words wey di king don command. So dem stop speaking with am, because di matter no dey perceived.
So Jeremiah remain for di court of di guard until di day wey Jerusalem dey captured.
